title: Pure Egyptian God
summary: Pure Egyptian God unites the three DIVINE Divine-Beast Creator Gods—Slifer the Sky Dragon, Obelisk the Tormentor, and The Winged Dragon of Ra—with their shared Slime and Crossing engine. Reactor Slime, Egyptian God Slime, and Soul Crossing allow you to Tribute Summon any of the three Egyptian Gods by Tributing tokens or your opponent's own monsters during either player's Main Phase.

allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Trap Monster summoned directly from the Deck by Reactor Slime that tributes itself during the Battle Phase to cheat out Egyptian God Slime.

main: Slifer the Sky Dragon
Egyptian God card that gains 1000 ATK/DEF per card in your hand and reduces the ATK of all monsters the opponent summons in Attack Position by 2000, destroying them if their ATK hits 0.
Obelisk the Tormentor
4000 ATK/DEF Egyptian God card that cannot be targeted by Spells, Traps, or effects and tributes 2 monsters to destroy all monsters the opponent controls.
The Winged Dragon of Ra
Egyptian God card that converts your LP into ATK/DEF via Ancient Chant and pays 1000 LP to destroy any monster on the field.
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode
Tributes 3 monsters your opponent controls to Normal Summon itself to their field, then tributes itself to summon a 4000 ATK/DEF Winged Dragon of Ra from your hand or Deck.
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix
4000 ATK/DEF form that Special Summons itself from the GY when Ra is sent from the field to the GY and pays 1000 LP to send a monster to the GY without targeting.
Reactor Slime
Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase for a 3-Tribute Summon, and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to set Metal Reflect Slime from hand, Deck, or GY.
Guardian Slime
Special Summons itself from the hand when you take battle or effect damage, and searches any Spell/Trap mentioning The Winged Dragon of Ra when sent from hand or field to the GY.
Soul Crossing
Quick-Play Spell that immediately Tribute Summons 1 Divine-Beast monster during the Main Phase by Tributing monsters from EITHER field (including your opponent's monsters!).
Ancient Chant
Searches The Winged Dragon of Ra from Deck or GY, grants an extra Tribute Summon this turn, and banishes from GY to give Ra the combined original ATK/DEF of its Tributes.
The True Name
Declares the top card of your Deck; if correct, adds it to your hand and adds or Special Summons 1 DIVINE monster directly from your Deck.
Mound of the Bound Creator
Field Spell that makes Level 10 or higher monsters on the field untargetable and indestructible by card effects, and searches a DIVINE monster when destroyed.
Millennium Revelation
Continuous Spell that sends a Divine-Beast from hand to GY to add Monster Reborn from Deck/GY, and allows Monster Reborn to revive The Winged Dragon of Ra.
The Revived Sky God
Normal Trap whose activation cannot be negated; revives Slifer the Sky Dragon from your GY and makes both players draw until they have 6 cards in hand.
Fist of Fate
Quick-Play Spell whose activation cannot be negated; while you control Obelisk, negates an opponent's Effect Monster and destroys it plus all Spells/Traps they control.
Metal Reflect Slime
Set from Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 3000 DEF to immediately transform into Egyptian God Slime.
extra: Level 10 Fusion boss summoned by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); counts as 1 or 3 Tributes for an Egyptian God, cannot be destroyed by battle, and protects your other monsters from attacks and targeting.
